instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-route marketing & workshop discovery website with React Router (or tab/page routing). Routes: Home, Services, Workshop, About, Gallery, Visit Us, Contact, Book Service.
STRICTLY NO E-COMMERCE: Do NOT add shopping cart, checkout, payment gateway, user accounts, product buying, order tracking, or shop dashboards.
Include both confirmed phone numbers (9007692978 & 9748615101) in header topbar, contact sections, sticky footer, and mobile bottom bar.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, gallery filters, dialog triggers).
Use Sonner for toast feedback when booking form is submitted or phone numbers are copied.
Implement demo booking submission state locally with reference ID generation and local confirmation modal/card.
Ensure dark mode editorial industrial aesthetic with high text contrast (APCA AA compliant).
